```{r}

# Load microbiome data
microbiome_ftbl <-  read.csv('DAG3_merged_metaphlan4_2024Sep.csv', row.names=1)
rownames(microbiome_ftbl) <- gsub(rownames(microbiome_ftbl), pattern="_metaphlan", replacement="")
microbiome_ftbl <- microbiome_ftbl[,grepl(x = colnames(microbiome_ftbl), pattern = paste(c("t__","UNCLASSIFIED"), collapse = "|"))]

# Load metadata
meta_case_control <- read.csv('meta_case_control.csv')

# Subset to the focal study population (individuals >=18 years)
microbiome_ftbl <- microbiome_ftbl[meta_case_control$DAG3_sampleID,]

```


```{r}

print("# Generate 100 stratified 70/30 train-test splits preserving case-control proportions")

R = 100

train_test_meta_ls <- lapply(seq_len(R), function(i) { list(train = NULL, test = NULL) })
train_test_ftbl_ls <- lapply(seq_len(R), function(i) { list(train = NULL, test = NULL) })

for (r in seq_len(R)) {
  set.seed(1000 + r)
  
  print(r)
  
  train_num_cases <- floor(table(meta_case_control$event)*0.7)[2]
  train_num_ctrl <- floor(table(meta_case_control$event)*0.7)[1]
  
  train_case_idx <- sample(1:length(meta_case_control$event[meta_case_control$event==1]), train_num_cases)
  train_ctrl_idx <- sample(1:length(meta_case_control$event[meta_case_control$event==0]), train_num_ctrl)
  
  train_meta <- bind_rows( 
    meta_case_control[meta_case_control$event==1,][train_case_idx,],
    meta_case_control[meta_case_control$event==0,][train_ctrl_idx,]
  )
  
  test_meta <- bind_rows( 
    meta_case_control[meta_case_control$event==1,][-train_case_idx,],
    meta_case_control[meta_case_control$event==0,][-train_ctrl_idx,]
  )
  
  train_test_meta_ls[[r]]$train <- train_meta
  train_test_meta_ls[[r]]$test <- test_meta
  
  train_ftbl0 <- data.frame(microbiome_ftbl[rownames(microbiome_ftbl) %in% train_meta$DAG3_sampleID,])
  train_ftbl0 <- driver::miniclo(train_ftbl0) # Keep UNCLASSIFIED in for normalization
  train_ftbl0 <- train_ftbl0[,-1] # Remove UNCLASSIFIED
  train_ftbl0 <- train_ftbl0[match(train_meta$DAG3_sampleID, rownames(train_ftbl0)),] # order rows in ftbl based on metadata
  
  test_ftbl0 <- data.frame(microbiome_ftbl[rownames(microbiome_ftbl) %in% test_meta$DAG3_sampleID,])
  test_ftbl0 <- driver::miniclo(test_ftbl0) # Keep UNCLASSIFIED in for normalization
  test_ftbl0 <- test_ftbl0[,-1] # Remove UNCLASSIFIED
  test_ftbl0 <- test_ftbl0[match(test_meta$DAG3_sampleID, rownames(test_ftbl0)),] # order rows in ftbl based on metadata
  
  train_test_ftbl_ls[[r]]$train <- train_ftbl0
  train_test_ftbl_ls[[r]]$test <- test_ftbl0
  
}

```

```{r}

print("# Function to select SGBs with the largest positive and negative log prevalence ratios between incident cancer cases and controls")

select_features_logPR_topK <- function(ftbl, 
                                       meta,
                                       min_prev = 0.1,
                                       K_pos = 150,   # case-enriched
                                       K_neg = 150,   # control-enriched
                                       eps = 0.01,
                                       min_ctrl_pos = 0) {
  
  case_idx <- meta$event == 1L
  ctrl_idx <- meta$event == 0L
  stopifnot(sum(case_idx) > 1, sum(ctrl_idx) > 1)
  
  X <- (as.matrix(ftbl) > 0) * 1L
  prev_cases <- colMeans(X[case_idx, , drop=FALSE])
  prev_ctrls <- colMeans(X[ctrl_idx, , drop=FALSE])
  
  # optional: stabilize denominator by requiring minimum number of positive controls
  if (min_ctrl_pos > 0) {
    ctrl_count <- colSums(X[ctrl_idx, , drop=FALSE])
    ok_ctrl <- ctrl_count >= min_ctrl_pos
  } else {
    ok_ctrl <- rep(TRUE, ncol(X)); names(ok_ctrl) <- colnames(X)
  }
  
  prev_max <- pmax(prev_cases, prev_ctrls)
  ok_prev <- prev_max >= min_prev
  
  logPR <- log((prev_cases + eps) / (prev_ctrls + eps))
  
  # candidates
  cand <- names(prev_cases)[ok_prev & ok_ctrl]
  
  # top-K helpers
  topK <- function(x, K, decreasing=TRUE) {
    x <- x[is.finite(x)]
    if (length(x) == 0) return(character())
    K <- min(K, length(x))
    names(sort(x, decreasing=decreasing))[seq_len(K)]
  }
  
  feats_pos <- topK(logPR[cand][logPR[cand] > 0], K_pos, decreasing=TRUE) # most positive
  feats_neg <- topK(logPR[cand][logPR[cand] < 0], K_neg, decreasing=FALSE)# most negative
  
  keep_feats <- union(feats_pos, feats_neg)
  
  list(
    keep_feats = keep_feats,
    prev_cases = prev_cases,
    prev_ctrls = prev_ctrls,
    logPR = logPR
  )
}


print("# Dimensionality-reduction: retain the 100 SGBs with the largest positive and negative log prevalence ratios (case- and control-enriched, respectively)")

selected_feats <- vector("list", R)
pr <- vector("list", R)

for (r in seq_len(R)) {
  print(r)
  
  train_meta <- train_test_meta_ls[[r]]$train
  train_ftbl <- train_test_ftbl_ls[[r]]$train
  
  pr_r <- select_features_logPR_topK(meta = train_meta, ftbl = train_ftbl, min_prev = 0.1, eps = 0.01, min_ctrl_pos = 5, K_pos = 100, K_neg = 100)
  
  pr[[r]] <- pr_r
  selected_feats[[r]] <- pr_r$keep_feats

}

```

```{r}

print("# Train elastic net Cox models")

# For each of the 100 outer train-test splits:
# 1. Binarize the SGBs selected within the training set
# 2. Fit an elastic net Cox model using 5-fold internal cross-validation
# 3. Extract features with non-zero coefficients at lambda.min
# 4. Calculate risk scores in the training and held-out test sets
# 5. Standardize test scores using the corresponding training-set mean and SD

nonzero_feats <- vector("list", R)
coefs_ls <- vector("list", R)
train_test_score <- lapply(seq_len(R), function(i) { list(train_score = NULL, test_score = NULL) })

for (r in seq_len(R)) {   
  
  set.seed(2000 + r)
  
  print(r)
  
  train_meta <- train_test_meta_ls[[r]]$train
  train_ftbl <- train_test_ftbl_ls[[r]]$train
  
  test_ftbl <- train_test_ftbl_ls[[r]]$test
  test_meta <- train_test_meta_ls[[r]]$test
  
  train_df <- data.frame(train_ftbl) %>% 
    rownames_to_column("DAG3_sampleID") %>% 
    left_join(train_meta)
  
  test_df <- data.frame(test_ftbl) %>% 
    rownames_to_column("DAG3_sampleID") %>% 
    left_join(test_meta)
  
  keep_feats <- selected_feats[[r]]
  
  # Elastic net - train model
  x_train <- as.matrix(train_df[, keep_feats, drop = FALSE])
  x_train <- (x_train > 0) * 1L # binary
  y_train <- Surv(train_df$time_to_event, train_df$event)

  nfolds=5
  foldid <- sample(rep(1:nfolds, length.out = nrow(x_train)))

  fit <- cv.glmnet(
    x = x_train,
    y = y_train,
    family = "cox",
    alpha = 0.5,
    standardize = TRUE,
    type.measure = "C",
    foldid = foldid
  )
  
  # Linear predictor and non-zero coefs
  beta <- as.matrix(coef(fit, s = "lambda.min"))
  nz <- setdiff(rownames(beta)[beta[,1] != 0], "(Intercept)")
  nonzero_feats[[r]] <- nz

  # Calculate score on both train and test data
  x_train_nz <- x_train[, nz, drop = FALSE]  
  
  x_test <- as.matrix(test_df[, keep_feats, drop = FALSE])
  x_test <- (x_test > 0) * 1L
  x_test_nz <- x_test[,  nz, drop = FALSE]
  
  lp_train_raw <- as.numeric(x_train_nz %*% beta[nz, 1])
  lp_test_raw <- as.numeric(x_test_nz  %*% beta[nz, 1])
  
  # Standardize using train mean/sd
  mu <- mean(lp_train_raw)
  sdv <- sd(lp_train_raw)
  if (sdv == 0 || is.na(sdv)) next

  train_df$risk_score <- (lp_train_raw - mu) / sdv
  test_df$risk_score <- (lp_test_raw  - mu) / sdv
  
  train_test_score[[r]]$train_score <- as.numeric(train_df$risk_score)
  train_test_score[[r]]$test_score <- as.numeric(test_df$risk_score)
  
  coefs_ls[[r]] <- beta[,1]

}

```

```{r}

print("# Function to summarize the stability of the estimated coefficients across iterations")

summarize_coefs <- function(
    coefs_ls, 
    sign_thresh = 0.9, # Required proportion of same-sign non-zero coefficients
    zero_tol = 1e-8 # Values with absolute magnitude <= this are treated as zero
) {
  
  # Collect all unique SGBs that received a coefficients in any iteration
  all_feats <- unique(unlist(lapply(coefs_ls, names)))
  
  # Number of re-sampling iterations 
  n_iter <- length(coefs_ls)
  
  # Create a feature-by-iteration coefficient matrix
  # The matrix is initialized with zeroes, so a feature is absent from an iteration is treated as having a coefficient of zero in that iteration
  
  coef_mat <- matrix(
    0,                    
    nrow = length(all_feats),
    ncol = n_iter,
    dimnames = list(
      all_feats, 
      paste0("iter_", seq_len(n_iter))
    )
  )
  
  # Populate the matrix with the estimated non-zero coefficients from each iteration
  for (i in seq_len(n_iter)) {
    cf <- coefs_ls[[i]]
    
    # Leave the corresponding matrix column as zero if no coefficient were retained in this iteration
    if (is.null(cf) || length(cf) == 0) next
    
    feats <- names(cf)
    vals  <- as.numeric(cf)
    
    coef_mat[feats, i] <- vals
  }
  
  # Return coefficicents that are meaningfully different from zero
  # Tiny values within +/- zero_tol are treated as numerical zeros
  get_nz <- function(x) {
    x[abs(x) > zero_tol]
  }
  
  # Selection frequency
  # Proportion of all iterations in which the feature had a coefficient with an absolute value > zero_tol
  selection_frequency <- apply(coef_mat, 1, function(x) {
    mean(abs(x) > zero_tol)
  })
  
  # Overall median coefficient
  # Median beta across all iterations, including zeros for iterations in which the feature was not selected
  median_beta <- apply(coef_mat, 1, median)
  
  # Directional consistency among selected features
  # Proportion of non-zero coefficients that were positive 
  prop_positive <- apply(coef_mat, 1, function(x) {
    nz <- get_nz(x)
    if (length(nz) == 0) return(NA_real_)
    mean(nz > 0)
  })
  
  # Proportion of non-zero coefficients that were negative 
  prop_negative <- apply(coef_mat, 1, function(x) {
    nz <- get_nz(x)
    if (length(nz) == 0) return(NA_real_)
    mean(nz < 0)
  })
  
  # Classify each feature according to the direction of its coefficient 
  class <- ifelse(!is.na(prop_positive) & prop_positive >= sign_thresh, "positive",
                  ifelse(!is.na(prop_negative) & prop_negative >= sign_thresh, "negative",
                         "unstable"))
  
  # Combine 
  out <- data.frame(
    feature = all_feats,
    selection_frequency = selection_frequency,
    median_beta = median_beta,
    prop_positive = prop_positive,
    prop_negative = prop_negative,
    class = class,
    row.names = NULL
  )
  
  # Order features from the highest to lowest selection frequency
  out[order(-out$selection_frequency), ]
}


print("# Run function on list of coefficients")

coef_summary <- summarize_coefs(coefs_ls, sign_thresh=0.9)

sel_feats <- subset(coef_summary, selection_frequency >= 0.9 & !class=="unstable") %>% 
  arrange(class, desc(median_beta)) %>% 
  pull(feature)


idx <-  1:100 
coef_mat <- matrix(0, nrow = length(idx), ncol = length(sel_feats),
                   dimnames = list(NULL, sel_feats))

for (j in seq_along(idx)) {
  r <- idx[j]
  b <- coefs_ls[[r]] 
  b <- b[names(b) != "(Intercept)"]  
  common <- intersect(names(b), sel_feats)
  coef_mat[j, common] <- b[common]
}

# Final coefficients: means across all iterations, including zeros when an SGB was not selected     
avg_coefs <- colMeans(coef_mat)

```

```{r}

print("# Compute risk score for all individuals")

# This assumes the order of the roes of microbiome_ftbl are the same as in meta_case_control

X_dev <- (as.matrix(microbiome_ftbl[, sel_feats, drop = FALSE]) > 0) * 1L
lp_ll_dev <- as.numeric(X_dev %*% avg_coefs)
mu_lp_ll_dev <- mean(lp_ll_dev)
sd_lp_ll_dev <- sd(lp_ll_dev)


plot_df <-
  meta_case_control %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    risk_score = ((lp_ll_dev-mu_lp_ll_dev)/sd_lp_ll_dev),
    risk_group = factor(ifelse(risk_score > median(risk_score), "High", "Low"), levels=c("Low","High")),
    time_to_event_yr = time_to_event / 365.25
  )

print("# Plot Kaplan-Meier survival curves")

km_plot <- survfit2(Surv(time_to_event_yr, event) ~ risk_group, data = plot_df) %>% 
  ggsurvfit(linewidth=2) +
  add_confidence_interval() +
  add_censor_mark(color="black", size=1, shape=3) +
  add_risktable(risktable_stats = "n.risk") +
  add_pvalue("annotation", size = 5) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("Low"="forestgreen", "High"="red3")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("Low"="forestgreen", "High"="red3")) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.text=element_text(size=15, color="black"),
    strip.background=element_blank(),
    strip.text=element_text(size=15, color="black"),
    panel.grid.major=element_blank(), 
    panel.grid.minor=element_blank(), 
    panel.background=element_rect(fill="white"),
    panel.border=element_rect(colour="black", fill=NA, size=1),
    plot.title=element_text(size=18, color="black"),
    axis.title=element_text(size=18, color="black"),
    axis.text.y=element_text(size=15,color="black"),
    axis.text.x=element_text(size=15,color="black")) + 
  labs(x="Time in years", y="Probability of remaining cancer-free")

ggsave("results/km_plot.png", plot=km_plot, width=6, height=4, units="in", dpi=300) 


print("# Impute and normalize risk factors for Cox regression")

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    # Convert categorical variables to factors
    dplyr::across(
      c(ANTHRO.Sex,
        EXP.SMOKING.Smoker.OneYear.Ever,
        MED.DISEASES.None.No.Diseases),
      as.factor
    ),
    # Replace missing values with the variable median
    dplyr::across(
      c(META.POOP.BristolMean,
        EXP.DIET.Scores.LLDietScore),
      ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x, median(.x, na.rm = TRUE))
    ),
    # Mean-center without scaling the standard deviation
    dplyr::across(
      c(ANTHRO.AGE, ANTHRO.BMI),
      ~ .x - mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )

print("# Run a multivariable Cox PH model")

cox_m <- coxph(
  Surv(time_to_event, event) ~ 
    risk_score + 
    ANTHRO.Sex + 
    ANTHRO.AGE + 
    ANTHRO.BMI + 
    MED.DISEASES.None.No.Diseases + 
    EXP.SMOKING.Smoker.OneYear.Ever + 
    META.POOP.BristolMean + 
    EXP.DIET.Scores.LLDietScore, 
  data = plot_df
)

cox_m_tidy <- tidy(cox_m)
write.csv(cox_m_tidy, file = "results/cox_model.csv")
```
